verses.gurmukhi: ੨੭ : ਚਉਪੜ ਦੀ ਖੇਲ ਵਾਙੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪੁਗਦੇ ਹਨ
verses.translit_en: 27 : chaupaR dhee khel vaan(g)oo gurmukh pugadhe han

en.bdb: Gurmukhs win as in a game of oblong dice

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਚਉਪੜ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣ ਭਉਜਲ ਸੈਂਸਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: eih jag chaupaR khel hai aavaa gaun bhaujal sai(n)saare|

en.bdb: This world is a game of oblong dice and the creatures go on moving in and out of the world-ocean.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋੜਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh joRaa saadhasa(n)g pooraa satigur paar utaare|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs join the association of the holy men and from there the perfect Guru (God) takes them across.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਗ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਪੁਗ ਜਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪੰਜ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: lag jai so pug jai gur parasaadhee pa(n)j nivaare|

en.bdb: He who devotes his self to the Guru, becomes acceptable and the Guru dispels away his five evil propensities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਆਪਹੁਂ ਬੁਰਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sahaj subhaau hai aapahu(n) buraa naa kisai vichaare|

en.bdb: The gurmukh remains in a state of spiritual calm and he never thinks ill of anybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਚਲੈ ਪਗੁ ਧਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saavadhaan gurmukh pa(n)th chalai pag dhaare|

en.bdb: Attuning consciousness with the Word, the gurmukhs alertly move with firm feet on the path of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh gur giaan mat bhai bhagat gur sikh piaare|

en.bdb: Those Sikhs, dear to the Lord Guru, behave in accordance with morality, religious scriptures and the wisdom of the Guru.
Through the means of the Guru, they stabilize in their own self.
